item.title: World Newswire Press Launches: A Global Newsroom Built to Give the World a Voice
item.dc:creator: By the World Desk, World Newswire Press
item.description: A new international news site and wire service goes live today, covering five regions of the planet, publishing its own reporting, and opening a Press Room where organizations anywhere can distribute their news.

item.title: COP31 Runs Into Overtime in Antalya as the Words 'Fossil Fuels' Vanish From the Draft Deal
item.dc:creator: By the World Desk, World Newswire Press
item.description: Nearly 200 countries missed Friday's deadline at the UN climate summit in Turkey. The fight is over whether the final text mentions moving away from oil, gas and coal at all.

media:content.media:credit: Photo: FingerWiki, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (taken in 2023)

item.title: Russian Missiles Hit Three Kyiv Bridges Over the Dnipro in a Second Strike on the City's Crossings in a Week
item.dc:creator: By the World Desk, World Newswire Press
item.description: Kyiv's mayor called it the biggest attack yet on the routes that join the two halves of the capital. At least eight people were killed across Ukraine, and the toll was still being counted.

media:content.media:credit: Photo: Maksym Kozlenko, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (taken in 2019)

item.title: World Court Rules Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya, a First for the ICJ
item.dc:creator: By the World Desk, World Newswire Press
item.description: In a 9-6 decision, the International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide in northern Rakhine State and ordered reparations. Making Myanmar comply is the next fight.
